instruction.text: Select true or false for the following statements.

atoms.a: Soil has the ability to help us tackle climate change.
Soil absorbs carbon dioxide and stores it as nitrogen.
Peat is the best soil for absorbing carbon dioxide.

instruction.text: Read the following text about a peat bog site in the UK and answer the questions.

atoms.text: A large peat bog near Manchester has started to dry up as a result of exposure to pollution and acid rain. In drying up, the bog is releasing carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere. To stop the bog from drying up, dams are being installed to try and keep the water in.

atoms.a: Why is the bog drying up?
b: There are too many animals living in it
It has become a building site
++It has been exposed to pollution and acid rain

atoms.a: How does this impact the environment?
How is this problem being addressed?
b: People are pouring water on it
